name: Lewis' Note
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Quartermaster Lewis sends a courier by gryphon to seek armor for Westfall's garrison. The order goes to a private armorer in Stormwind.

sections.title: A Plea for Steel
sections.body: The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill receives little support from Stormwind's House of Nobles. Skirmishes with the Defias Brotherhood keep wearing down its small supply of gear. So Quartermaster Lewis turns to private trade to keep the defenders equipped. His order goes outside the kingdom's military channels. An Alliance courier must fly by gryphon to Old Town and present it to Osric Strang, who owns Limited Immunity.

faq.answer: Lewis' Note is Quartermaster Lewis's written order to Osric Strang, an armorer in Stormwind, asking him to send protective gear to the Westfall garrison.
Quartermaster Lewis wrote the note. He manages supplies, provisions, and armaments for the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill.
The note first goes to Thor, the gryphon master at Sentinel Hill. From there, it travels to Osric Strang at his armor shop, Limited Immunity, in Stormwind's Old Town.

faq.q: Why doesn't the garrison just get armor from the kingdom?
faq.answer: Stormwind's government has largely neglected Westfall. Its defenders receive neither direct military funding nor armor from the crown, so Lewis relies on traders such as Osric Strang to equip the militia.

angles.text: As a human adventurer, carrying the order shows you how to use the kingdom's gryphon routes. It also shows how little Stormwind's rulers do to equip Westfall's defenders.
